title: Create the Dataset Candidate aggregate and sole creation seam

verify.summary: Verifier reran candidate_aggregate (13 passed) and migration_compatibility (11 passed) gates plus mb-lint and diff-check against current state; independent 20/20 PostgreSQL probe confirmed persisted defaults (candidate|raw|standard|split=null|confirmation_source=null|can_train_on=false, record_version=1, null curator-run identity), 7 named PG enum columns + 6 checks + source-identity/curator-run uniques + RESTRICT FKs, one redacted dataset_candidate_created ref, same-source idempotency vs new-source UUID behavior, structural rejection of authority fields, append-failure rollback, append-success/commit-failure noise, and single linear Alembic head ft014_dataset_candidates with direct parent ft013_decision_effects. No HTTP/transition/source-wiring/agent-runtime surface introduced. Forward drift: 10 historical feature migration head-pin tests assert ft013_decision_effects; outside this task's gates and documented in handoff; does not invalidate this verdict. Evidence: .protocols/TASK-047-T3-FT-014-W1/verification.md.

Adversarial semantic verifier: independent 22/22 PostgreSQL probe (exact enum sets, source-identity isolation, farm/archived/consultant denies, concurrent same-source single row via unique constraint, exact event payload/redaction/cardinality, tz-aware timestamps, downgrade removes table+dataset_* enums, single linear head ft014_dataset_candidates<-ft013_decision_effects); static checks confirm sole writer in service.py:90, no external imports/api routes, no agent-runtime call; rerun gates candidate_aggregate 13 passed, migration_compatibility 11 passed; findings none blocking.

purpose: Establish one PostgreSQL Dataset Candidate aggregate and the only service that creates a raw candidate from an already-authorized canonical source row, so every later transition and source integration consumes one writer instead of duplicating defaults or source identity.
success_outcome: An additive migration and Dataset Governance service persist one native-UUID candidate per named source identity with exact enums/checks, record_version=1, ordered audit refs, null curator-run identity, and candidate|raw|standard|split=null|confirmation_source=null|can_train_on=false defaults; the creation seam rejects caller authority fields, appends one redacted dataset_candidate_created ref, is idempotent only for the same source row, and exposes no HTTP, transition, source wiring, or agent runtime.
anti_goals: Lifecycle transitions, evidence association, source-owner wiring, or Dataset Agent execution.
A partial index without a predicate, mutable-current-head pin, public endpoint, export, split assignment, or historical backfill.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-001 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: no pre-existing Dataset Candidate aggregate or supported writer exists, so a behavior-equivalent default row cannot be invoked without first creating this task-owned schema/seam; alternative proof: preflight catalog/source absence plus GREEN exact new-row/default/forbidden-input/event-ref matrix; decisive comparison: persisted columns, named source uniqueness, and one redacted event ref; artifact: focused PostgreSQL pytest transcript under .tasks/TASK-047-T3-FT-014-W1/.

FT-014-AC-001 migration proof: GREEN upgrade/downgrade creates/removes the exact enums/table/checks, normal uq_dataset_candidates_source_identity, nullable unique curator_run_id, record_version and event_refs while preserving one dynamic linear Alembic head; decisive comparison: catalog/model parity and ancestry; artifact: migration gate transcript.
constraints: Use named normal source identity uniqueness because every key column is non-null; a new source-row UUID is new evidence, not an idempotent retry.
Generate the migration from the linear head discovered at executor preflight; do not pin the planning-time head.
Creation and Timeline append participate in the caller-owned UoW; append failure rolls back, while append-success/commit-failure is non-authoritative noise.
invariants: Dataset Governance is the only Dataset Candidate writer and every new candidate is non-trainable by default.
Timeline and event_refs are audit/export correlation only and cannot reconstruct candidate state.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-001: focused PostgreSQL service tests compare exact persisted defaults, rejected authority fields, same-source duplicate versus new-source identity behavior, event ref shape/redaction/cardinality, append failure rollback, and append-success/commit-failure noise.
FT-014-AC-001: migration tests compare SQLAlchemy/catalog constraints and types, direct down_revision to the executor-discovered head, upgrade/downgrade, and no branch/ancestry regression.
